title: Ta'amti Bourekas (Frozen)
instructions: Place the frozen bourekas on a parchment-lined baking sheet, seam side down.
Bake 25-30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden brown.
Cool a few minutes before eating — the filling is very hot.
notes: Store-bought frozen staple. 1 serving = 2 bourekas (the package serving size is 1 piece). Filling: potato — pareve; the household buys potato / non-dairy. The potato package's own printed directions could not be found online, so the directions here are standard bake-from-frozen. Confirm exact directions from the package; Yidi will send a package photo from home.
